palette.effective_tile_primary: w: RandomColors.MainColor changes ColorString only. TileColor is unspecified on the builder, so declared Render.TileColor=&w remains and Cell prefers it for tile rendering.
palette.effective_detail: Native creation chooses one of eight DetailColor values independently of glyph MainColor (PairDetailWithForeground defaults false). Declared R is a fallback/example, not every painting.
palette.ownership: Opaque source R=0 is primary, R=255 detail; A is object coverage. Keep masks separate and apply runtime values. No palette clocks or resampling of native random choices.
